author: hattrill
body:

colon cancer-associated protein mic1 pthr12897

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
UniProtKB:Q9VRX1 Bulli FBgn0035703 	
guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

	This has been curated by PMID:32499409 IDA by REFG (so I think that would be from the PAINT annotation pipeline)

Mon1 and Ccz1 are all that is required for the GEF activity of the complex. Bulli acts as structural component. Looking at the structure in PMID: 37216550, I have curated Bulli as enabling 'protein complex scaffold activity' (and updated  the FB adaptor annotation in PMID:32499409 to the same) - which I think is the right one to propagate.
title: PAINT issue:colon cancer-associated protein mic1 pthr12897

author: marcfeuermann
body: It's funny, actually. I requested this term a while back because I noticed that many genes were being annotated incorrectly when following the current guidelines. I never imagined it would be this popular. Unfortunately, while it’s available for almost all annotations, it’s still not available for PAINT, so I’m getting a ton of tickets asking me to annotate the term I created, and for now I can’t. So I’m going to file this ticket with the others, until we can make progress. :-)
